usedFor: Getform collects your web form entries and HubSpot holds your contacts, so “New form submission” runs “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New form submission” in Getform, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each form entry becomes a HubSpot contact, so leads do not sit in an inbox.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, and “New form submission” in Getform is polling, so entries arrive after a short delay.
